events.title: Czech Senate constituent session re-elects Vystrčil President (69 votes) and elects Drahoš, Oberfalzer, Václavec and Grolich vice-presidents
Cabinet meeting: fuel-price cap extension not taken up (Schillerová absent); Martin Kozák named head of the new Land Development Office
events.note: The cabinet decision on the caps was carried as claim cz-fuelcap-ext-20 in the cz-diesel story (a separate cz-cabinet story was dropped in planning); the Kozák appointment was not covered.
